summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2005-7 filed a Form 8-K on October 14, 2026 furnishing a preliminary remarketing memorandum for its Class A-5 Reset Rate Notes. Navient Solutions, as administrator, will remarket up to $119,517,663.33 of Class A-5 notes, originally issued August 11, 2005, through remarketing agents to qualified institutional buyers. If successfully remarketed on October 26, 2026, the notes price at 100.00% of par with a SOFR-based rate, next reset January 25, 2027 and legal maturity January 25, 2040. Existing holders must submit hold notices by noon New York time on October 21, 2026, or be deemed tendered; watch subscription levels and pricing spreads.
